definitions.gloss: many years; long years; for a long time
definitions.explanation: A period spanning many years; used to describe something that has continued for a long time.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{夢|ゆめ}が{叶|かな}った。
{長年|ながねん}{使|つか}っている{道具|どうぐ}だ。
examples.english: It's a tool I've been using for many years.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{経験|けいけん}が{役|やく}に{立|た}った。

notes:
{長年|ながねん} emphasizes duration over many years.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長年|ながねん}の{夢|ゆめ} (long-held dream)
- {長年|ながねん}の{経験|けいけん} (years of experience)
- {長年|ながねん}の{研究|けんきゅう} (years of research)
- {長年|ながねん}にわたる (spanning many years)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {長い間|ながいあいだ}: for a long time
- {何年|なんねん}も: for many years
